# name: # One session per line, tab-separated. "YESTERDAY" in name/created_at is replaced at seed time
# so the recency case stays true whenever the suite runs. All names, people, and events are synthetic.

title: Fix flaky TestListingHandler_Timeout by pinning the fake clock
summary: TestListingHandler_Timeout in internal/listing failed roughly one run in twenty because the handler read the real clock for its deadline while the test advanced a fake one. Pinned the handler to the injected clock and removed the sleep. Verified with go test -count=200 ./internal/listing/: 200 of 200 runs green. The flake is fixed; no production behavior changed.

title: Bump golang.org/x/net and re-run the dependency audit
summary: Routine dependency bump after the weekly advisory scan. No API changes; go test ./... green; audit report attached to the PR.

title: Release notes for 1.4.2
summary: Drafted the 1.4.2 release notes from the merged PR list. Called out the listing API pagination fix and the new ACME_ARTIFACT_STORE_URL override.

title: Lint: enable errcheck across cmd/ and fix the fallout
summary: Turned on errcheck, fixed 14 unchecked Close and Write calls. One behavior change: main now exits non-zero when the artifact upload response body cannot be closed.

title: Investigate nightly compaction window growth
summary: The store's compaction window grew from 2-8s to 4-15s over August. Opened a ticket with the storage team; no code change. Retry policy (ADR-007) still covers the window.

title: CI: cache Go modules and cut PR build time in half
summary: Added actions/cache for the module and build cache. PR builds went from 6m to 2m40s.

title: Document local development setup in README
summary: Wrote the quick-start section: go build, env vars, how to point at a local artifact store. No code change.

title: Settle configuration precedence and record ADR-012
summary: Riley's staging deploy read a committed .acme/config.toml over the environment. Wrote ADR-012 establishing env > local file > team defaults with no cross-layer merging, and updated config.Load() to log which layer each value came from.

title: Staging deploy read a committed config file over the environment
summary: Staging pointed at production for eleven minutes because a committed .acme/config.toml overrode ACME_ARTIFACT_STORE_URL. Rolled back. Escalated to Sam for a precedence decision.

title: Add jitter tests for the shared retry helper
summary: Table-driven tests for the backoff schedule: 200ms, 400ms, 800ms with full jitter, cap at 3 attempts, no retry on 4xx.

title: Shared retry helper with capped exponential backoff (ADR-007)
summary: Implemented the retry helper decided in ADR-007: exponential backoff from 200ms, factor 2, full jitter, maximum 3 attempts, never on 4xx. Left the uploader untouched for Avery to migrate.

title: Reliability review follow-ups
summary: Filed the action items from the reliability review: Devon owns the shared retry helper, Avery migrates the uploader, Riley tracks the compaction window with the storage team.

title: Rename listing handler options for clarity
summary: Renamed PageOpts to ListingOptions and updated call sites. No behavior change.

title: Paginated listing API
summary: Added internal/pagination with half-open Bounds and Count, wired into the listing handler. Table-driven tests cover first, middle, last-partial, and beyond-end pages.

title: Upgrade Go toolchain to 1.24
summary: Toolchain bump; fixed two vet warnings about copying locks. All tests green.

title: Investigate 503s from the artifact store during nightly compaction
summary: Traced three on-call pages to the store's compaction window returning 503 for 2-8 seconds. Recommended capped retries at every call site; escalated to the reliability review.
